summary: A hand-entered triangle can now be typed into, pasted into, and linked while it is shown a year at a time over finer figures.
details: Only a view that groups the rows is still read-only, and its message now names that one control: set the Origin Length back to edit.
While the columns are grouped, the status line says in one line that a save writes each figure at its own column date and clears the periods between.
A vector keeps the wording it already had, because it has no columns to group.
